list.title: Fa'amauina
list.empty: E leai ni resitala e fetaui ma nei filiga.

override.title: Pule Sili
override.hint: O fa'asili e fa'amauina i taimi uma ma lou fa'asinomaga ma lou fa'aupuga - aua ne'i gugu.
override.cancelBookingHint: O le fa'aleaogaina e fa'ailogaina ai le resitaraina ma lona komisi ua fa'aleaogaina, toe fa'afo'i le pule fa'atino i le pa'aga, ma toe tu'u le faufale e tusi lenei ta'imua.
override.cancelBookingConfirm: Fa'aleaogaina lenei tusi resitala? Ua faaleaogaina foi lona komisi. O lo'o fa'amauina ma lou igoa ma lou mafua'aga.

detail.disputeOpen: O lo'o matala se fe'ese'esea'iga o le pule i lenei tagata fa'atau - fai mai le isi paaga o latou. E filifili i luga o le itulau Feeseeseaiga.

cancellation.title: Ua faaleaogaina tusi
cancellation.hint: Ua faaleaogaina le resitalaina ma lona komisi; ua toe fo'i le pule fa'agaioiga ma le paaga ma e mafai e le faufale ona toe tusi le ta'ita'i lea.

disputes.title: Feeseesea'iga o le Pule
disputes.hint: O se paaga na teena lona resitalaina o se kopi e mafai ona finau poo ai e ana le tagata faatau. Toe iloilo itu uma e lua ma filifili.
disputes.empty: Leai se feeseeseaiga ma lenei tulaga.

detail.title: Feeseesea'iga {{id}}
detail.heldMissing: E le'i maua le resitala na taofia.
detail.noteRequired: Tusi se faamatalaga e filifili ai.
detail.upholdEffect: {{holder}} tausia le tagata fa'atau. Ua tapunia le feeseeseaiga ma e leai se isi mea e suia.
detail.overturnEffect: {{holder}} 's puipuiga fa'alua ua muta nei ma ua lesitala le tagata fa'atau mo {{partner}} o se resitala fou.
